🥒 NEW: Electrical engineer Joshua Méndez Harper demonstrated an electrified #pickle at an Electrostatics Society of America meeting.

His #PortlandState team monitored a pickle with a high-speed camera and #hydrogen sensor, finding that alternating current produces both #electrolysis and a stable vapor pocket. Sparks across that gap ignite the hydrogen and #oxygen, creating the glow.
